hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight text-[#1A3626] font-bold

typography.instructions: Do not use 'Inter' or 'Roboto'. Use 'Merriweather' for an approachable, classic feel that instills trust. Use 'Work Sans' for ultra-high legibility in long form reading. Ensure no text is smaller than 16px (text-base) to accommodate elderly users.

colors.instructions: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy. Primary is a Deep Forest Green for trust and health. Secondary is Terracotta for warmth and urgency (CTAs). Background is a warm Sand/Bone-white (#F9F6F0) to reduce eye strain compared to pure stark white.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft, diffuse shadows (e.g., shadow-lg shadow-[#1A3626]/5) for cards. Avoid harsh or dark drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8DE (soft green-tinted grey) for defining containers without cognitive overload.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous Spacing (p-8, p-12) to create breathing room. Do not cram elements. Elderly users need high structural clarity.
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards and buttons. Friendly, soft, no sharp aggressive corners.

layouts.general: Minimal cognitive load. One clear action per section. High contrast.
layouts.navigation: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/95. VERY explicit labels (e.g., 'Book a Service' instead of 'Services'). Do not hide desktop links behind a hamburger menu.
layouts.hero: Asymmetrical layout. Large, high-contrast text on the left, warm emotional image on the right. If using an image overlay, use bg-white/40 max.
layouts.dashboard: Soft, clear grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2). 'Upcoming Appointments' and 'Active Subscriptions' front and center. Avoid nested tabs or complex hidden menus.

components.buttons: Large tap targets (min-h-[56px] or py-4 px-8). text-lg font-semibold. Pill-shaped or rounded-full.
components.forms: Inputs must be large (h-14). Use STATIC labels (never floating labels, they confuse elders). Always include explicit placeholder text. Minimal required fields.
components.cards: bg-white rounded-3xl p-8 border border-[#E2E8DE] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow.
components.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn components but override their default tight sizing. Make everything 20% larger. Use 'lucide-react' icons (size 24 or 28, stroke 1.5) for navigation and actions.

motion.rules: Extremely gentle. Prefer simple opacity fades and slight y-axis translations (translate-y-2). MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion. No aggressive parallax, 3D, or high-speed tickers.

rules: Minimum 16px body text, preferred 18px-20px for core reading.
Contrast ratio > 4.5:1 for all text. Use APCA guidelines.
Clear, highly visible focus states (ring-2 ring-[#D97757] ring-offset-2).
Explicit button labels (e.g., 'Submit Delivery Request' not just 'Submit').

hero.description: Caregiver assisting elderly couple, use in Landing Page Hero section to establish immediate trust.

service_caretaker.description: Nurse smiling with elderly patient. Use in 'Our Services' or 'Caretakers' section.

service_medicine.description: Pharmacist organizing medication. Use for the 'Medicine Delivery' service highlight.

testimonial_happy_user.description: Happy senior couple. Use in testimonials, about us, or subscription success states.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT output standard 'AI slop' (generic centered layouts, cramped spacing, arbitrary gradients).
CRITICAL: Do not center-align the main App container. Left-align paragraphs and dense content for natural reading flow.
CRITICAL: Do not use `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition: transform 0.2s, opacity 0.2s`.
CRITICAL: NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡🎯) as icons. Always use `lucide-react` icons (e.g., HeartPulse, Pill, CalendarCheck).

CRITICAL: Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive and key informational elements (buttons, links, form inputs). Use kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid='book-service-button'`).
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays. Always use a solid color or backdrop-blur with high opacity (bg-white/95).
CRITICAL: Forms MUST use Shadcn components (Form, Input, Select) and Sonner for toast notifications (`/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`).
CRITICAL: Write only standard javascript/jsx for frontend files (.js or .jsx), avoid using typescript interfaces or types.
CRITICAL: Prioritize large tap targets and >4.5:1 text contrast. Build for users aged 65+.
